case_number: Criminal Appeal No(s). 793-794 of 2022; Criminal Appeal No. 795 of 2022
summary: Conviction for murder; kidnapping for ransom; conspiracy; destruction of evidence; confession leading to recovery of body and murder weapon; DNA evidence linking appellant's hair to victim; standard: benefit of doubt not granted due to consistent testimony and corroborative circumstantial evidence; death penalty confirmed for multiple offences under IPC.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; death sentences upheld; conviction confirmed on all counts.
